items.question: What twelve-syllabled mantra is declared as the fire-consort in the liquid oblation?
premises: The context concerns the liquid oblation (drave).
The fire-consort (vahnivadhū) is identified as a mantra.
This mantra is specified as having twelve syllables.
items.inference: Therefore, the twelve-syllabled mantra designated here is declared to be the fire-consort in the liquid oblation.
uncertainties: The exact syllabic form of the twelve-syllabled mantra is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: In the liquid oblation, this twelve-syllabled mantra is declared to be the consort of fire.
